== Summary ==
Slip of [[Strong Is Vader]] (Virtual Block 6.1, slip 89) as printed in the '''first copy''' of the Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (“Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV”, “Official text as of September 4, 2009”; PDF made 3 September 2009, attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf on the [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum]). It shows the '''original''' text (“6 different Jedi Tests”, “(cannot be canceled while you occupy a battleground)”). The revised sheet's slip ([[:File:VB6-89-Strong_Is_Vader.png]]) and the Players Committee card image show the later PC-E1 text ([[Strong Is Vader (Errata)]]).

* '''Original text:''' “If [Virtual] Mind What You Have Learned on table, deploy on table with up to 6 different Jedi Tests under here from outside your deck. You may not Force drain at Dagobah locations or deploy asteroid sectors, [Maintenance] cards, or [Permanent Weapon] cards. Whenever you draw training destiny, draw two and choose one. You may retrieve 3 Force whenever you complete a Jedi Test (cannot be canceled while you occupy a battleground). Completed Jedi Tests are placed on table and are suspended (not lost) whenever character who completed them not on table.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026, cropped from page 12 of that PDF rendered at 400 dpi, scaled to 757 px wide (as the other Virtual Block 6 slip files).
* Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
